title: WalkthroughAvailabilityDocument
description: The one staff calendar that walkthrough slots come from: weekly windows in India time, a slot length, a lead time and closed dates. Server-only; the website reads open slots through getWalkthroughSlots, which names no staff. No document means the built-in default calendar is in use: Monday to Friday, 10:00 to 18:00 IST, 30-minute slots, 2 hours' lead, 14 days ahead (functions/src/walkthroughs/calendar.ts). A saved document replaces it, including one that closes booking.

utcOffsetMinutes.description: India keeps UTC+05:30 all year; slots are computed with this fixed offset, never a daylight-saving rule.

revision.description: Raised by one on every save; a save names the revision it read.
